title: Turkish Style Pea Kisir
description: A traditional Turkish dish made with split peas, perfect for a quick and energizing meal. This vegan version is a healthy and flavorful take on the classic.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and red pepper and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the split peas and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the chopped parsley and lemon juice.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the peas are tender.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
